units.source_text: 我仿佛听见一个声音：你也必须作出最后的决断。

en.t: I seemed to hear a voice saying: you too must make your final decision.

units.source_text: 于是我马上鼓起勇气，响应那个声音。

en.t: So I immediately summoned my courage and answered that voice.

units.source_text: 我一定要抢在K的前头，并且瞒着他做这件事情，我暗暗窥伺着机会。

en.t: I had to act before K, and do it without his knowing; in secret, I watched for my chance.

units.source_text: 但是，两天过去了，三天过去了，我也没有找到机会。

en.t: But two days passed, then three days passed, and still I found no opportunity.

units.source_text: 我是在等待K和小姐都不在家的时机，跟夫人单独谈这件事。

en.t: I was waiting for a time when both K and the young lady were out, so I could speak to the madam alone about the matter.

units.source_text: 可是，这个没在家，那个却在，反正总有一个在家，妨碍我的计划，就这么一天天地拖延下来，一直没能找到一个好时机。

en.t: But when one of them was out, the other was home; one way or another, someone was always there to obstruct my plan, and the days slipped by without my ever finding the right moment.

units.source_text: 一个星期之后，我终于忍受不住，采用了装病这一招。

en.t: After a week, I could no longer bear it, and finally resorted to pretending to be ill.

units.source_text: 早上，夫人、小姐和K都催我起床，我只是哼哼唧唧地躺在被窝里不起来，一直耗到十点左右。

en.t: That morning, the madam, the young lady, and K all urged me to get up, but I only lay in bed under the covers, groaning vaguely, and stayed there until around ten.

units.source_text: 估摸着K和小姐都走了，家里安静下来的时候，我才起了床。

en.t: Only when I judged that K and the young lady had both gone out and the house had grown quiet did I get out of bed.

units.source_text: 夫人一看到我起来了，就问我哪儿不舒服，

en.t: As soon as the madam saw that I was up, she asked me where I felt unwell,

units.source_text: 还关切地说：‘我把饭送到你枕边来，你再睡一会儿的好。’

en.t: and said with concern, 'I will bring your meal to your bedside; you had better sleep a little longer.'

units.source_text: 我本来就没病，实在不想再睡了，洗了脸，就像平常那样在客厅吃饭。

en.t: Since I was not ill to begin with, I really had no wish to sleep any more; I washed my face and ate in the sitting room as usual.

units.source_text: 当时，夫人坐在长火盆对面给我盛饭。

en.t: At the time, the madam was sitting across from the long brazier and serving me rice.

units.source_text: 我手里端着说不上是早饭还是午饭的饭碗，

en.t: Holding in my hands a rice bowl that could hardly be called either breakfast or lunch,

units.source_text: 心里一直琢磨着该怎样开这个口，

en.t: I kept turning over in my mind how I should bring the matter up,

units.source_text: 所以在外人看来，也挺像是个不舒服的病人。

en.t: so to an outsider I must have looked quite like a patient who truly felt unwell.
